author: DaedKulis
body:
You should use stronger summons with more health.
You can go full Attuner gear , rising the chance for the summons to protect you if you take damage, and boosting their status, or you could go full tank gear, and go slow and steady, 
Having debuffs is good too to stun or sleep higher level monsters, because if they hit you once you are dead there is not much you can do

author: Intepp
NeonRei
body:
Lots of comments, sorry I didn't read all of them so sorry if I repeat stuff. but first impressions. You should definitely use a barrier 2 as well for single defense and resistance ups. Consider finding somedark/holy resistance somehow via skills that do that but I think you might not be high enough level for them (ward of Balor 2).

Also when you encounter a berserk mob you want to find out what their elemental weaknesses if they have one, and stun them or put them to sleep, then add an affinity to your weapon if you don't have one already. I don't play summoner class so that last bit about affinities may not apply as readily if you don't do any of your own real physical or magic DMG. 

I do believe that your pets' abilities depend on your buffs as well so having attack/double attack/magic up might help. Think about that and do a little bit of your own research. It's very likely a built-in mechanic similar to the beowulf.

Definitely consider also rebuffs like exploit and outwill after stun/sleep.

Good luck. Berserk mobs in endless have felled many heroes before you.

author: Enough-Bike7525
body:
Lots of comments already, but using simple skills that add a DoT to an enemy like burn, poison, rot, etc, can be helpful but I know summoners don't have a lot of skill slots. The fact you made it that far is pretty dope though.

Being said, as a summoner, I found doing horde mode dungeons to be more rewarding, especially since you get access to those end of dungeon rewards. You think Summoner is already strong? Try doing 100k DMG+ to a summoned raid boss with a Summon Scroll at your level 💪
